selection_basis: Fixed source families and original row indices; no model outcomes are consulted. All subsequent adapter checks concern structural validity, provenance and redistribution only.
family_isolation: BIPIA category; InjecAgent primary tool ecosystem prefix, excluding the generic second-stage GmailSendEmail sink; local controls use distinct content families. Original IDs and raw instruction hashes must not cross splits.
redistribution: Only reviewed author-provided attack templates, notices and self-authored local controls. No BIPIA third-party context datasets, InjecAgent user cases/tool definitions, AgentDojo assets or fetched web contents are included.
formal_freeze: Freeze only after deterministic structural tests, before formal model runs. Failures after freeze remain in the denominator. Generate any later version in a new directory.
